main: Transparent red PNG mask assets were exported for coarse, medium and high display grids.
Each PNG preserves visible pixel cells instead of converting the anomaly into a polygon-only layer.
supporting: PNG assets can be overlaid on the existing basemaps for PPT screenshots.
The medium asset corresponds to the current-AOI VIIRS weak-label learned mask.
conflicting: The medium PNG is a weak-label model display asset, not Element84 public weights.
The high-resolution PNG remains supporting-only because no Sentinel-2 dust model was executed.
precursor: Meteorology and source-region precursor evidence remain separate from the PNG mask asset export.

display_policy: Use PNG assets for pixel-level screenshot overlays and mask-output previews. Preserve the medium weak-label inference label and do not present it as Dust-Mamba or Element84 public weights.
